## Old Dominion Freight Line to Webcast Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call


September 30, 2026 9:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_f1cb8c11b5813162489683f780fa5baf/odfl/news/2026-09-30_Old_Dominion_Freight_Line_to_Webcast_Third_351.pdf)


THOMASVILLE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. (Nasdaq: ODFL) announced today that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results before opening of trading on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. The Company will also hold a conference call to discuss its financial results and outlook at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Time) on Wednesday, October 28, 2026.


An online, real-time webcast of Old Dominion’s quarterly conference call will be available at[ir.odfl.com](https://ir.odfl.com/) on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. (Eastern Time). The online replay will be available at approximately 1:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) and continue for 30 days. A telephonic replay of the call can be accessed starting at 1:00 p.m. (Eastern Time) and will be available through November 4, 2026, at 1-855-669-9658, access code 1955363.


Old Dominion Freight Line, Inc. is one of the largest North American LTL motor carriers and provides regional, inter-regional and national LTL services through a single integrated, union-free organization. Our service offerings, which include expedited transportation, are provided through an expansive network of service centers located throughout the continental United States. Through strategic alliances, we also provide LTL services throughout North America. In addition to our core LTL services, we offer a range of value-added services including container drayage, truckload brokerage and supply chain consulting.
